title: Projective geometrically normal core of curve completion
statement: Let k be a field and X a separated finite type k-scheme of topological dimension at most one [def-weil-field, def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. There are a projective k-scheme T of dimension at most one and a dense open k-immersion a:X→T [def-kun-projective, def-weil-open-immersion], and a finite purely inseparable extension K/k [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. The base change T_K [def-pc-fibre-product] has a family c_i:C_i→T_K of integral closed subschemes, indexed by Fin n for some natural n, whose distinct supports enumerate exactly the irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components]. After every field extension L/K, all stalks of the base change of the coproduct of the normalizations of C_i are integrally closed domains [def-sc-normalization, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family].

proof.text: Choose the dense projective completion T and its structure map and open immersion. Retain its dimension bound and commutativity equation.

Projectivity implies properness, hence local finite type and quasi-compactness. Apply geometric normalization after finite purely inseparable extension to T, and return its finite component family and universal normal-stalk assertion.

theorem exists_projective_geonormal_core
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (a : X ⟶ T),
      IsHProjective g ∧ topologicalKrullDim T ≤ 1 ∧ IsOpenImmersion a ∧
      a ≫ g = X ↘ Spec (.of k) ∧ DenseRange a ∧
      ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra k K),
        Module.Finite k K ∧ IsPurelyInseparable k K ∧
        ∃ (n : ℕ) (C : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (hC : ∀ i, IsIntegral (C i))
          (c : ∀ i, C i ⟶ pullback g
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))),
          (∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (c i)) ∧
          Function.Injective (fun i ↦ Set.range (c i)) ∧
          (∀ Z : Set (pullback g
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}),
            Z ∈ irreducibleComponents
                (pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}) ↔
              ∃ i, Set.range (c i) = Z) ∧
          ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L],
            ∀ z : ↥(pullback
              (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ @Scheme.fromNormalization (C i) (hC i) ≫ c i) ≫
                pullback.snd g
                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))),
              IsDomain ((pullback
                (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ @Scheme.fromNormalization (C i) (hC i) ≫ c i) ≫
                  pullback.snd g
                    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).presheaf.stalk z) ∧
              IsIntegrallyClosed ((pullback
                (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ @Scheme.fromNormalization (C i) (hC i) ≫ c i) ≫
                  pullback.snd g
                    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).presheaf.stalk z)
